personality_one_liner: A sharp, high-contrast operational command center for tracking workouts and resting, driven by oversized metrics and energetic ember-orange accents.

spacing.rule: Dense but legible. Generous paddings on main layout roots, but tighter tracking inside metric blocks to feel like a dashboard.

do's: Avoid glass entirely. Rely on solid surface hierarchy and dividers for a sharp, tactical feel.
dont's: No blur over dark images, no translucent sheets. Everything should feel durable and solid.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Current active plan, quick start session, and glanceable weekly progression.
screens.layout: Top section: large greeting and 'Start Workout' sticky block with hero_workout_bg. Middle: horizontal stats cards (volume, hours this week) featuring thin charts. Bottom: List of recent workout sessions.

screens.name: Import Plan
screens.purpose: Photo capture/upload flow and AI parsing visual state.

states.loading: Full screen ai_scanning_bg image with vertical linear gradient sweeping overlay representing AI extraction.
states.error: AI could not parse text. Retry button.

screens.layout: Viewfinder UI over camera preview placeholder. Bottom block containing upload buttons. Once photo is taken, transitions to a scanning screen with overlay lines and progress percentage.

screens.name: Active Workout
screens.purpose: Log current sets, weight, and reps.
screens.layout: Header: Current exercise name and large current set indicator. Body: List of sets (target vs actual reps, weight inputs) using surfaceTertiary cards. Bottom sticky: Large primary CTA 'Log Set & Rest'.

screens.name: Rest Timer
screens.purpose: Full-screen or bottom-sheet countdown timer with sound alerts.
screens.layout: Presented as a modal/sheet. Center: Massive BarlowCondensed countdown numerals inside a circular progress ring (brand color). Below: Quick actions (+15s, Skip Rest). Bottom: 'Up Next' exercise preview.

screens.name: Stats & History
screens.purpose: Visualize volume and frequency trends, list past sessions.

states.empty: empty_state image of dumbbells. 'Complete a workout to see stats.'

screens.layout: Top: Tabbed view (History / Stats). Stats view: bar/line charts using brand color with thin lines and no grid. History view: vertical list of past sessions showing duration and volume in compact rows.

ai_scanning_bg.alt: abstract red and blue lines scanning on black

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the Dark-First Utility DARK guidelines. Do not use any blue, purple, or indigo tones anywhere. Ember Orange is the sole accent.
No glassmorphism. Use solid surface hierarchy (surface -> surfaceSecondary -> surfaceTertiary) and 1px dividers to segment content.
Typography: Use Barlow Condensed (500) for all large numbers, counters, and main headings. Use Manrope (500) for UI body text and labels. Do not exceed weight 500.
Image Scrims: Ensure that `hero_workout_bg` has a vertical linear gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) so overlaid text remains completely legible.
The Rest Timer screen needs to feel massive and glanceable. Use a very large font size (e.g., 80px+) for the countdown, wrapped in an SVG circular progress indicator.
Build the Import Plan 'scanning' state by overlaying an animated or stylized vertical line on `ai_scanning_bg` to simulate AI processing the photo.
All primary CTAs (like 'Start Workout' or 'Log Set') must be sticky at the bottom of the screen (respecting safe areas) so the user doesn't have to scroll for them.
